title: Unit Event — Cheer With My Heart! — Episode2 True Idols

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! has received an invitation to the Lumina Grand Prix, an idol TV program organized by Ms. Arisawa. At the orientation, the legendary idol speaks of the idea of a "true idol", which resonates with Airi.

rows.Line: Event Venue

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Around the world...?
Also, what did she mean by “true idols”...?)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: That being said, I'm sure this is a bit confusing for you all.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: So, I'd like to tell you a little story...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: In another life, I had the honor of being an idol. Just like all of you. I admired my seniors very much, and a thought occurred to me while chasing after them...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Idols have the power to become the “light” that their fans look towards.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: All of you have probably realized by now that not everything in this world can be fun and games.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Sometimes, no matter how hard you try, things don't go your way. Your work goes unrewarded.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I'm sure that some of you were pushed to the point of wanting to give it all up for good.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Because that happened to me...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: After I made my debut, I struggled to gain any traction. Everything I did seemed to go to waste. I felt like giving up on many occasions...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: But each time, my seniors gave me a bit of hope.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
Their shows were always so dazzling...
I couldn't help but smile every time I saw them perform.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: But that wasn't all.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
Even after they finished performing...
Their behavior backstage, in green rooms and in their personal lives...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: They were always smiling and spreading hope to fans and staff alike.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: No matter how tired they were... No matter what was bothering them or causing them pain, they kept looking ahead with a smile.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
Their auras were blinding...
So much so that I didn't want to give up. I decided that I was going to be just like them.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: They lit up not only my heart, but the hearts of a great many fans.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: That is why I think true idols are those who can spread hope simply by being who they are.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: And most importantly, they must have hearts full of persistent optimism. That is my solemn belief.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (They need to have heart... That sounds like...)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I'm sorry if my story ended up being a little long.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll begin explaining what competing in the Lumina Grand Prix actually involves.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
This competition consists of two parts—
The prelim stage and the final stage.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Considering the nature of this program, you'll be told the rules of each stage while we're on the air.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Next, regarding how it will be broadcast...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Everything from practice sessions to the time you spend preparing will all be streamed live online.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Live...?!

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: People will not only be watching your stage performances, but also the way you live day to day.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because “true idols” spread hope simply by being who they are...?

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: In addition, the most important moments will be broadcast on television. That includes the announcement of any results, as well as your actual performances.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: With regards to the final stage, that will be broadcast around the world on NetParadise.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, NetParadise...?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's going to be broadcast on TV and NetParadise...?

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
On NetParadise...
The biggest streaming service in the world...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-This is way bigger than I imagined. My head's starting to spin...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Until now, NetParadise has never carried an idol program such as this.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: However, by showing them how idols are a unique part of Japanese culture, we convinced them to come on board.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: My hope is to introduce this country's idol culture to the world, as well as your brilliance.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Ms. Arisawa's serious...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (She wants us to spread hope to the entire world...)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Next, I'll be going over the schedule, as well as the process for participating in this competition. I ask that you all please take a look at the papers we handed out...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: That concludes this explanation.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Now, to finish... My hope is that through this program, you'll all be able to shine even more brightly as true idols...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line:
And become that light.
Become beacons of hope that so many people will look towards.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Those who wish to achieve that goal are more than welcome to enter.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: As an idol fan myself, I'll be looking forward to seeing your brilliance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Th-That totally blew me away...!
The Lumina Grand Prix's super gigantic!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes...
It's a much grander event than I initially realized...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah. Also...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ms. Arisawa said she wanted us to become the light people will look towards.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's right in line with our goal of spreading as much hope as we can.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah! Not only that, she wants us to spread that light to people all around the world.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No idol worth their salt would wanna pass up this chance!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: As she explained it, I felt that this program was perfect for all of you as well!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
But there's also risk involved...
From what I understand, you'll be bound to it for a very long time. Plus, everything is going to be livestreamed, so you can't edit your way out of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But we're used to just being ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That's how we do our streams all the time!

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: That's right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, even if we do have to push ourselves a bit, it should be worth the cost.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This is a huge opportunity for MORE MORE JUMP! to get out of our bind.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. If we do manage to make it to the final stage, people around the world will learn about MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If we want to make our dream a reality, then there's no reason for us not to enter.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Looks like we're all in agreement.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's safe to say our future hangs on this competition.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, in order to spread hope to as many people as we can, and to make our dream come true, let's go at this with everything we have!
